detail.dangerDescription: Conversations bound to it fall back to a single agent. Past runs are kept.
detail.deleteBody: This removes the Squad and its members. Runs it has already produced stay in the run history.
detail.missingDescription: It was deleted, perhaps in another window. Pick another from the list.
detail.noMembersDescription: Add teammates from a template, or from the Squad's own run surface.
